title: Course project
reading: Administrative slide outlining the course project. Projects may be on any interesting topic related to AI and agents, whether theoretical or applied, with teams of 2 to 3 students; examples are drawn from CSCE 625 Artificial Intelligence (Spring 2026). Links are given to a shared Google Slides presentation deck and a Google Sheets team sign-up form. Teams must sign up by 11:59 pm today (Wednesday), and the presentation order will be decided the following day.
